      "author": "Livio Gamassia",
      "body": "* feat(brief): run a bounded evidence brief on every code prompt, simplify the agent prompt

The prompt-submit task-event hook (the only prompt hook `pixel install`
registers, for Claude Code and Codex) now returns a [PIXEL:BRIEF] block as
additional context: anchors, files, the symbol definition and, for rename or
caller intent, its direct callers. It runs at most four ops (search-content,
find-symbol, impact <uid>, find-code) under one 750 ms deadline, caps output
at 2 KiB, reads a warm daemon or the index and graph read-only, and never
starts a daemon or builds an index. PIXEL_BRIEF=0 or `brief: false` in
.pixel/config.yaml turns it off.

The agent prompt drops the flat command table for the brief paragraph plus
one chain per case, 4430 -> 1782 bytes; the sub-agent prompt 1764 -> 869.

Refs #865

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(architecture): correct the brief paragraph (Pi gets none, stale graph keeps text evidence)

Pi is skipped by start_brief, and a missing or stale graph still yields the
files: evidence with the reason under unresolved:; only a repository with no
index gets no brief. Review feedback on #866.

Refs #865

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(hooks): retire the guard, rewrite and retrieval hook handlers (#867)

* refactor(hooks): retire the guard, rewrite and retrieval hook handlers

`pixel install` registers only `run-hook task-event` for Claude and Codex,
and PR #866 delivers retrieval context through its prompt-submit event, so
the other hook handlers no longer have a registration path.

Deleted: the guard (rewrite/deny/advisory arms and the AGY pre-invocation
path), composed-guard, post-tool-use, metrics, session-start,
post-compaction and the legacy prompt-submit handlers with their modules
and ~5,300 lines of tests; the plugin hook script and plugin-hooks.json;
the OpenCode plugin asset. `search-like-rg`, `execution-brief` and
`squash-branch` (alias `rewrite`) are untouched.

Kept so an upgrade cannot break a host: every retired verb stays accepted,
with its old flags, as a hidden silent no-op that exits 0 (a PreToolUse hook
that exits 2 blocks the host's tool call), and the install and uninstall
recognisers that retire old registrations. `pixel config policy` now
controls nothing; its key and wording stay.

Refs #865

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(plugin): remove the pixel-impact skill, the per-prompt brief replaces it

The Claude, Codex and Qoder plugins no longer ship the pixel-impact skill:
the [PIXEL:BRIEF] from the prompt-submit task event runs find-symbol and
impact <uid> itself. The three old skill copies join RETIRED_FILES so a repo
that still has them gets them cleaned. The Pi /pixel-impact command, the
pixel-classify skill and the `pixel impact` command stay.

Refs #865

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(brief): quote the definition source line in the evidence brief

find-symbol resolves the declaration site but not what the symbol is — for `export const X = defineMultiStyleConfig(...)` a bare `defined:` entry let the agent describe the symbol wrongly. When a symbol resolves, append its first source line to the defined entry; when none resolves (const bindings the extractor does not index), quote the file hit whose stem matches the anchor as `likely definition:`. Arena on architech-t (3 reps): literal-lookup quality 21/30 -> 30/30 at 0 commands and ~13K input tokens.

* fix(ci): guard the native rg spawn and inline the format args
